lines.en: label chikachristmalloween2:
scene chikaconfesses1
: Really? So just like that, your parents are back? No explanation? No talk? Just, “Hey, Futaba. We still exist. Here’s your allowance?”
lines.zh: : 真的？就那么突然，你父母就回来了？没有解释？没有谈话？就一句「嘿，Futaba。我们还活着。这是你的零用钱？」

lines.en: : There was a talk, it was just brief. Apparently, the entire company my father is contracted to was barred from communicating with anyone for the duration of their last project.
lines.zh: : 有谈过，只是很简短。据说我父亲签约的那家公司，在上一个项目期间被禁止与任何人联系。

lines.en: : And that included your mom as well? Isn’t that a little...I don’t know...crazy? Like, what the hell does he do? Isn’t he just an architect?
lines.zh: : 连你妈妈也算在内？那是不是有点……我不知道……疯了？他到底是干什么的？他不就是个建筑师吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. He’s done government jobs before, so I imagine it was something like that. Maybe they’re just a little more strict in America than they are over here?
lines.zh: : 嗯。他以前接过政府的项目，所以我想大概是那类工作。也许美国那边比这边更严格一点？

lines.en: : That’s so awesome! Because, not to to drag the mood down, but I was really starting to worry that they were just straight up dead.
lines.zh: : 那太好了！因为——我不想扫兴——但我真的开始担心他们是不是干脆就死了。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses2
: Thanks for clarifying that you weren’t trying to bring the mood down. Because it sure sounded like you were.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你澄清你不是在扫兴。因为听起来确实很像。

lines.en: : Damn, Rin. You really just came out and said it?
lines.zh: : 靠，Rin。你真就这么说出来了？

lines.en: : What? We were all worried about it.
lines.zh: : 什么？我们大家都很担心啊。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses3
: But now we don’t have to be because we’ve confirmed they’re safe! Do you think they’ll come back to Japan soon? It’s been years since I’ve seen them. I want to hug your mom. She’s soft.
lines.zh: : 但现在不用了，因为我们已经确认他们平安！你觉得他们很快会回日本吗？我好几年没见他们了。我想抱抱你妈妈。她软软的。

lines.en: : I think they’re still stuck over there for the time being. You know...on account of the giant wall surrounding Kumon-mi and the ongoing space war.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他们暂时还困在那边。你知道的……因为环绕 Kumon-mi 的那堵巨墙，还有持续的太空战争。

lines.en: : Just ask Touka for some help smuggling them back in. Her family practically runs this city, don’t they? I’m sure they can go in and out whenever they want.
lines.zh: : 找 Touka 帮忙把他们偷运回来不就好了。她们家几乎掌控了这座城市吧？我敢肯定她们想进就进、想出就出。

lines.en: : I don’t think they’re in any hurry to get back. And I don’t want to pressure them into thinking they have to for me. I’m just glad they’re safe.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他们不着急回来。而且我也不想逼他们觉得必须为了我而回来。他们平安就够了。

lines.en: : Well, I’m happy for you, Futaba. And I am also glad your parents aren’t dead.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我为你高兴，Futaba。也很高兴你父母没死。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses4
: Me too. Thank you, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我也是。谢谢你，Otoha。

lines.en: : I wonder if my biological parents are still alive? I wonder what they’re like if-
lines.zh: : 我在想我的亲生父母还活着吗？我在想他们会是什么样的人，如果——

lines.en: : Rin, we need to talk.
lines.zh: : Rin，我们得谈谈。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses5
: Oh, Chika. Hey. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 哦，Chika。嗨。一切都好吗？

lines.en: : How’d your talk with Yumi go? Is Chosoguchi back on?
lines.zh: : 你跟 Yumi 谈得怎么样？Chosoguchi 复合了吗？

lines.en: : Please tell me you didn’t tell her about that.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我你没跟她说那个。

lines.en: : Not on purpose.
lines.zh: : 不是故意的。

lines.en: : It was...fine. Can you just come outside with me? It won’t take long.
lines.zh: : 还……行。你能跟我出来一下吗？不会太久。

lines.en: : Oh...yeah. Sure.
lines.zh: : 哦……好。当然。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses6
: I’ll...be right back, I guess. I want to hear more about your parents and how alive they are.
lines.zh: : 我……马上回来。我还想多听听你父母的事，还有他们有多活着。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses7
: Huh...
: Is it me or did that seem kind of serious? Chika’s normally a lot livelier than...whatever that was.
lines.zh: : 是我多心还是刚才气氛有点严肃？Chika 平时可比……刚才那样活泼多了。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses8
: That, Futaba — is how she’s finally going to confess.
lines.zh: : 那个啊，Futaba——就是她终于要去告白的样子。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses9
: What? But Rin already-
lines.zh: : 什么？可 Rin 已经——

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses10
: Not Rin, dummy. Chika.
lines.zh: : 不是 Rin，笨蛋。是 Chika。

lines.en: : Chika?! But...Chika doesn’t like Rin. Chika’s obsessed with Sensei. That’s like...half of her personality. Why would you think that?
lines.zh: : Chika？！可……Chika 不喜欢 Rin 啊。Chika 迷的是 Sensei。那几乎是……她一半的人格了。你为什么这么想？

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses11
: You just start to pick up on things like this when you’ve been around the block as many times as me. I was basically the prince of my last school, remember?
lines.zh: : 你像我这样经验丰富之后，自然就会察觉这种事。我以前可是上一所学校的王子，记得吗？

lines.en: : Besides, why else would Chika always get so possessive around her? Girl’s had it out for me since the moment Rin and I started dating. She’s liked her this whole time. She just didn’t realize it.
lines.zh: : 再说了，不然 Chika 为什么总在她面前占有欲那么强？从我和 Rin 开始交往那刻起，那姑娘就一直针对我。她一直都喜欢她。只是自己没意识到。

lines.en: : Neither did I...
lines.zh: : 我也没看出来……

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses12
: Hey, that’s not your fault. You were born without gaydar. You’ve gotta leave stuff like this to the experts.
lines.zh: : 嘿，那不是你的错。你天生没有同性恋雷达。这种事得交给专家。

lines.en: : Otoha...Chika can’t confess to Rin.
lines.zh: : Otoha……Chika 不能跟 Rin 告白。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses13
: What? Why not?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么不行？

lines.en: : Because Rin’s finally accepted that she likes Sensei! If Chika confesses to her, she’ll have no idea what to do and start spiraling out of control again! That’s what she does!
lines.zh: : 因为 Rin 好不容易才接受自己喜欢 Sensei！要是 Chika 跟她告白，她会完全不知所措，然后又开始失控打转！她就是这样的！

lines.en: : Well, if she likes Sensei, can’t she just turn Chika down?
lines.zh: : 嗯，可要是她喜欢 Sensei，直接拒绝 Chika 不就行了？

lines.en: : You really think Rin is going to turn a girl that attractive down?! Especially one she crushed on for years?!
lines.zh: : 你真觉得 Rin 会拒绝一个那么有吸引力的女孩？！尤其是她暗恋了好几年的对象？！

lines.en: : Well, what do you suggest we do then? Because Chika and I might be pseudo-enemies, but I’m not about to go get in the way of her shooting her shot.
lines.zh: : 那你说我们该怎么办？Chika 和我说不定算半个敌人，但我可不打算去拦她表白。

lines.en: : Then I will. I can’t let Rin go through that again. Not when she’s always looking out for me and-
lines.zh: : 那我去。我不能让 Rin 再经历一次那种事。尤其她总是那么照顾我，而且——

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses14
: Oh, no. You’re not going anywhere either. I am stronger than you and I am keeping you right here.
lines.zh: : 哦，不行。你哪儿也别想去。我比你壮，我会把你按在这儿。

lines.en: : But Rin is-
lines.zh: : 可 Rin 是——

lines.en: : Rin is a lot stronger now than you probably think. Chika and I made sure of that. And her finally following her heart is all the proof you need that she’s not just some crazy disaster lesbian anymore.
lines.zh: : Rin 现在比你以为的坚强得多。这点是我和 Chika 保证的。而她终于追随自己的心意，就是最好的证据——她不再是那个一团糟的灾难拉拉了。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses15
: She can handle this. Just trust her, okay?
lines.zh: : 她扛得住的。相信她就好，好吗？

lines.en: : I really hope you’re right, Otoha...
lines.zh: : 我真希望你说得对，Otoha……

lines.en: : Me too. Because I’ll look like a fucking idiot if I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我也是。因为要是不对，我就成他妈的傻子了。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses16
: Chika, what’s going on? Why did we have to come all the way outside to-
lines.zh: : Chika，怎么了？我们干嘛非得跑到外面来——

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses17
: Rin! Just...hold on, okay? Let me do the talking or I’ll just...
lines.zh: : Rin！就是……先别说话，好吗？让我来说，不然我会……

lines.en: : I’ll get distracted and forget everything I wanted to say. And there’s a lot, so...please bear with me. I’ve never done this before.
lines.zh: : 我会分心，然后把想说的话全忘光。而且要说的好多，所以……拜托忍一下。我从没做过这种事。

lines.en: : Never done what before? What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 从没做过什么？你在干嘛？

lines.en: : That’s what I’m trying to get to! Just shut up, okay?! This is hard enough without your reassurance!
lines.zh: : 我正要说啊！闭嘴好吗？！本来就够难了，你别再给我打气了！

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses18
: I’m sorry, I...I didn’t mean to yell.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我……我不是故意要吼的。

lines.en: : I’m just a little nervous...that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点紧张……就这样。

lines.en: : This isn’t like when we talk in your room...or my apartment...or in the locker room or at school or any of the million places we talk now that we see each other every day.
lines.zh: : 这跟我们在你房间……或我家……或更衣室、学校，还有现在我们每天见面聊天的无数个地方都不一样。

lines.en: : And if that sounded like me complaining, it’s not. I love the time we spend together and I’ve...grown closer to you in the last year than I have with almost anyone I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 要是那听起来像我在抱怨，那不是。我喜欢我们在一起的时光，而我在过去这一年里……跟你变得比跟我认识过的几乎任何人都亲近。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses19
: I hate myself sometimes, you know. For not talking to you sooner. For missing out on time we could have spent together while we were off doing our own things and...
lines.zh: : 我有时候恨自己，你知道的。恨自己没早点跟你说话。恨我们各自忙各自的时候，错过了本可以一起度过的时光，而且……

lines.en: : And I wonder a lot how we’d be if that never happened. If one of us did approach the other when we were younger.
lines.zh: : 我常常想，要是那从没发生过，我们会是什么样。要是我们小时候有谁先走上前搭话。

lines.en: : I wonder if I’d have stopped bleaching my hair sooner. How different my wardrobe would be and whether or not we’d be sharing clothes.
lines.zh: : 我在想我会不会早点就不漂头发了。我的衣柜会有多不一样，我们会不会共用衣服。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses20

: Because I’d, like...I’d obviously be buying less gyaru stuff if that were the case since you don’t like dressing that way! And I’ve never really had much money to begin with, so...you know. Limited disposable income and...
lines.zh: : 因为我会，那个……要是那样，我显然会少买些辣妹风的东西，毕竟你不喜欢那种打扮！而且我本来就没什么钱，所以……你懂的。可支配收入有限，而且……

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses21
: Wait, no. Fuck. That’s not what I...uhh...I think I’m starting to get off topic. Hold on.
lines.zh: : 等等，不。操。我不是那个……呃……我觉得我开始跑题了。等一下。

lines.en: : Can I say something?
lines.zh: : 我能说句话吗？

lines.en: : No. Not yet. Not until I’m done. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 不。还没。等我说完。抱歉。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses22
: Hooh...
: Okay.
scene chikaconfesses23
: Rin — I know I have hurt you in the past. And I know that, right now, you are probably very uncomfortable around me due to certain things that I may have done in your bedroom.
lines.zh: : Rin——我知道我过去伤害过你。我也知道，现在你在我身边大概很不自在，因为我在你卧室里可能做过的某些事。

lines.en: : I don’t regret it. Quite the opposite, actually. And even though we’ve already talked about it, I don’t think I adequately explained myself last time. Especially since we were both naked.
lines.zh: : 我不后悔。事实上恰恰相反。虽然我们已经谈过一次，但我觉得上次我没把话说清楚。尤其是当时我们俩都光着身子。

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika——

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses24
: You are way more than just a friend to me! So much so that I feel myself getting crazier and crazier every single day as I force myself to deny it! But I can’t anymore!
lines.zh: : 你对我来说远远不止是朋友！远远到——我每天逼自己否认这一点，就感觉自己一天比一天疯！但我再也做不到了！

lines.en: : I hate it when other people look at you. I hate it when you look at other people. I hate it that I’m not the center of your world anymore.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌别人看你。我讨厌你看别人。我讨厌自己不再是你世界的中心。

lines.en: : And I hate that I have to hold myself back around you when all I really want to do is drag you into the nearest closet and make you blush so hard that you pass out!
lines.zh: : 我讨厌在你身边必须克制自己——而我真正想做的，是把你拖进最近的储物间，让你脸红到晕过去！

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses25
: I don’t think I realized how hard I fell for you until you told me you were going to go after Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我想，直到你告诉我你要去追 Sensei，我才意识到自己陷得有多深。

lines.en: : That was the moment I knew. And the first time since I met him that there was someone else I wanted to lock away in a place that no one else could get to.
lines.zh: : 那就是我明白过来的时刻。也是我认识他之后第一次，想要把另一个人锁在一个谁也到不了的地方。

lines.en: : I hate it. I hate imagining you with some other person. Even if it’s him. Even if he is the one you love because he is not me.
lines.zh: : 我恨这种感觉。我恨去想象你跟别的什么人在一起。哪怕是他。哪怕他是你爱的人，因为他不是我。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry if this is, like...super random and sudden...
lines.zh: : 还有，如果这听起来……特别突然和莫名其妙……我很抱歉……

lines.en: : But I think I’m in love with you and if I didn’t admit that tonight, I’d probably just die.
lines.zh: : 但我想我是爱上你了，要是今晚不承认，我大概会死掉。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses26
: Fuck. Hold on, no. There was more. I skipped a whole part. I should have rehearsed this longer. I should have-
lines.zh: : 操。等下，不对。还有一段。我跳过了整整一段。我该多排练几遍的。我该——

lines.en: : You’re in love with me?
lines.zh: : 你爱上我了？

lines.en: : Yes! Yes. Madly. Obsessed, even. I legitimately can not stop thinking about you and it is driving me fucking insane.
lines.zh: : 是！是的。疯狂地。甚至可以说是痴迷。我真的没办法不去想你，这快把我他妈的逼疯了。

lines.en: : And this is...a confession?
lines.zh: : 那这是……告白？

lines.en: : This is me trying to make you understand that anything you are confused about is 100%% my fault.
lines.zh: : 这是我在努力让你明白——你任何困惑的地方，100% 都是我的错。

lines.en: : And that it isn’t you just getting the wrong idea or not understanding me because no rational person would look at what I’m doing right now and get it. I barely get it.
lines.zh: : 而不是你误会了、或者不懂我——因为任何理智的人看到我现在做的事都不会懂。我自己都快不懂了。

lines.en: : You’re sure?...
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？……

lines.en: : You’re sure it’s me?
lines.zh: : 你确定是我？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why?! Fucking look at you! You’re the cutest fucking thing I’ve ever seen!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！他妈的看看你自己！你是我见过最他妈可爱的东西！

lines.en: : And you’re funny and loyal and reliable and smart and the way you always smell like coffee makes me want to fucking...blend you up and pour you all over my body! Ugh!
lines.zh: : 而且你有趣、忠诚、可靠、聪明，还有你身上总带着咖啡味，让我他妈的想……把你搅碎了浇满我全身！啊！

lines.en: : Chika, I...
lines.zh: : Chika，我……

lines.en: : I don’t know what to say...
lines.zh: : 我不知道该说什么……

lines.en: : Never in a million years did I think you’d look at me like this...
lines.zh: : 我做梦都没想到你会这样看我……

lines.en: : It’s just...a lot to take in...
lines.zh: : 只是……信息量有点大……

lines.en: : Well...
: You can take all the time you need, Rin...
lines.zh: : 你需要多久都行，Rin……

lines.en: : Because the decision I’ve made is this.
lines.zh: : 因为我做出的决定是这样的。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses27
: I don’t think we should hang out anymore.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们不该再见面了。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses28
: What?...
: At least...
lines.zh: : 至少……

lines.en: : At least not for a while...
lines.zh: : 至少暂时不要……
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : I don’t get it...
lines.zh: : 我不明白……

lines.en: : You’re confessing to me and telling me to go away at the same time?...
lines.zh: : 你一边跟我告白，一边叫我走开？……

lines.en: : What is that supposed to mean?...How am I supposed to take that?...
lines.zh: : 这算什么？……我该怎么理解？……

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses29
: Heh...Ridiculous, right?
lines.zh: : 呵……很荒谬吧？

lines.en: : A little bit, yeah...
lines.zh: : 有一点吧，嗯……

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses30
: I’m not myself anymore, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我不再是原来的我了，Rin。

lines.en: : I’ve fucked things up with Yumi. My relationship with Sensei is going up in flames. Like, shit, I even fell into the yandere archetype at work because I can’t get my fucking head on straight.
lines.zh: : 我把和 Yumi 的关系搞砸了。我和 Sensei 的关系正在燃烧。操，我甚至在上班时变成了病娇那一型，因为我他妈的脑子一团乱。

lines.en: : That’s not your fault, of course. It’s mine for not fully understanding myself in the first place.
lines.zh: : 当然这都不是你的错。是我的错——一开始就没能真正搞懂自己。

lines.en: : I need to get back to normal. I have a little sister to take care of. And a friend who needs my support now more than ever.
lines.zh: : 我需要回到正常状态。我有个妹妹要照顾。还有一个比以往任何时候都需要我支持的朋友。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to do any of that if you’re there? I made you the center of my world before you even had a chance to turn me down.
lines.zh: : 要是你在那儿，我怎么做得到这些？我在你还没来得及拒绝我之前，就把你变成了我世界的中心。

lines.en: : This isn’t the Chika you fell for back in middle school, right? You said it yourself — that I’ve been acting crazy lately. And I don’t want to be that way anymore. So I think I...
lines.zh: : 这已经不是你中学时喜欢上的那个 Chika 了，对吧？你自己说过——我最近举止很疯。而我不想再那样了。所以我想我……

lines.en: : I think I need to be alone for a little while. Being around you is...
lines.zh: : 我想我需要独处一阵子。待在你身边是……

lines.en: : Well, it’s just too painful.
lines.zh: : 嗯，只是太痛苦了。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses31
: I’m really sorry, Rin.
lines.zh: : 真的很抱歉，Rin。

lines.en: : I’ll leave you alone now.
lines.zh: : 那我不打扰你了。

lines.en: : Don’t fucking move.
lines.zh: : 他妈的别动。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses32
: Huh?
: I said don’t move. We’re not done here.
lines.zh: : 我说了别动。我们还没说完。

lines.en: : But I-
lines.zh: : 可我——

lines.en: : I will flash you if I have to. You’re not going anywhere until I have the chance to respond.
lines.zh: : 有必要的话我就对你露给你看。在我有机会回应之前，你哪儿也别想去。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses33
: What does that do other than make this even harder?! Sensei’s the one you want! I was just a fucking question mark that showed up and made your life all shitty again!
lines.zh: : 那除了让事情更难还有什么用？！Sensei 才是你想要的人！我只是一个他妈的问号，冒出来又把你的生活搞得一团糟！

lines.en: : Who cares if it makes it harder?! You think I don’t know how hard it is to try and be normal around someone you feel that way about?! I did it with you every day for years!
lines.zh: : 谁管它会不会更难？！你以为我不知道，在你对一个人有那种感觉时还要装作正常有多难吗？！我跟你一起时，每天都这样过了好几年！

lines.en: : And yes, Sensei is the one I want right now! But that doesn’t mean you’re not special to me too! Yet here you are, trying to cut me off! What the fuck?!
lines.zh: : 没错，Sensei 是我现在想要的人！但那不代表你对我来说不特别！可你现在却想跟我一刀两断！搞什么鬼？！

lines.en: : I need to, Rin! You don’t understand! I’ll lose sight of everything else if I stay with you!
lines.zh: : 我必须这样，Rin！你不明白！要是继续跟你在一起，我会失去其他一切！

lines.en: : Then let me help you!
lines.zh: : 那就让我帮你啊！

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses34
: With what?! Raising a kid?! Helping someone deal with cancer?! Coming to terms with the guy I’ve been seeing for years cheating on me while you actively pursue him?!
lines.zh: : 帮什么？！带孩子？！帮人面对癌症？！接受那个我交往多年的人背叛我、而你还在主动追他这件事？！

lines.en: : Are you actually ready to help with any of that, Rin?! This is bigger than just a confession! This is my life we’re talking about!
lines.zh: : 你真准备好要帮这些了吗，Rin？！这可不止是一场告白！我们说的是我的人生！

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses35
: And sometimes, you need to sacrifice something you love if it means protecting everything else.
lines.zh: : 而有时候，你需要牺牲自己爱的东西，才能保护其他一切。

lines.en: : What the- how can you say that with a smile?!
lines.zh: : 什么——你怎么能笑着说这种话？！

lines.en: : Because I know you’ll be okay...
lines.zh: : 因为我知道你会没事的……

lines.en: : And that one day, we’ll be able to talk again without me wanting to keep you all to myself.
lines.zh: : 而且总有一天，我们还能再说话，而到那时我不会再想把你占为己有。

lines.en: : When that happens, I hope I’m closer to the old me than the one I am now.
lines.zh: : 到那时候，我希望自己更接近以前的我，而不是现在的我。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses36
: But even more than that...
lines.zh: : 但比这更重要的是……

lines.en: : I hope that you’re exactly the same.
lines.zh: : 我希望你一点都没变。

lines.en: : Tell Yumi I said bye, okay?
lines.zh: : 替我跟 Yumi 说声再见，好吗？

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses37
: Please don’t walk away from me.
lines.zh: : 求你别走。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Rin. This, too, is all my fault.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Rin。这也是我的错。

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses38
: I know where you live! I’ll just come find you!
lines.zh: : 我知道你住哪儿！我会去找你的！

lines.en: : Please don’t, Rin...I really need your help with this. Even now, I want to smother you. And so long as I feel that way, I can’t-
lines.zh: : 别这样，Rin……这事我真的需要你帮我。就算现在，我也想把你闷死在怀里。只要我还这么想，我就——

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses39
: Do it...
lines.zh: : 那就做吧……

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: : Smother me. Smother me if that will keep you from leaving. I love you, Chika.
lines.zh: : 闷死我吧。只要能让你别走，就闷死我吧。我爱你，Chika。

lines.en: : But is it the same way I love you?
lines.zh: : 可那跟我爱你的方式一样吗？

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses40
: Don’t go...
lines.zh: : 别走……

lines.en: : I need to...
lines.zh: : 我必须……

lines.en: : But on the bright side...
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想……

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses27
: I’ll still see you in school!
lines.zh: : 我们在学校还是能见面的！

lines.en: scene chikaconfesses41
scene black
$ chika_love += 100
$ chikachristmalloween2 = True
Chika’s affection has forcibly increased to [chika_love]!
lines.zh: Chika 的好感度被强制提升到了 [chika_love]！

lines.en: An hour later...
lines.zh: 一小时后……
